user.title: Namudri Elektro
user.description: Select the Shelly (or other) power sensor in W and the Slovenian network tariff block sensor (1–5).

data_description.name: Name of the device that groups all Namudri entities.
data_description.power_sensor: Import power of the whole house in W (export counts as 0 W).
data_description.tariff_sensor: Sensor with the current network tariff block (1–5), e.g. from Elektro Network Tariff.

shedding.title: Load shedding
shedding.description: Optional. Priority order = list order (first shed first). Only active in tariff blocks 1 and 2. Leave empty for monitoring only. Pick the mobile apps (or other notify services) that should be notified on every shed/restore.

data_description.devices: Switches, climate or water heater entities that may be turned off. The first one in the list is shed first.
data_description.notify_services: Notify services that get a message on every shed and restore. Leave empty for no notifications.

reconfigure.title: Namudri Elektro — change sensors
reconfigure.description: Change the name or the two source sensors. Devices, notifications and all numbers are kept.

data_description.name: Name of the device that groups all Namudri entities.
data_description.power_sensor: Import power of the whole house in W (export counts as 0 W).
data_description.tariff_sensor: Sensor with the current network tariff block (1–5), e.g. from Elektro Network Tariff.

error.same_sensor: The power sensor and the tariff sensor must be different.

abort.already_configured: This combination of sensors is already configured.

source_entity_not_found.message: Source entity {entity_id} was not found (yet). Home Assistant will retry.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Namudri Elektro entry with ID {entry_id}.

no_loaded_entry.message: Namudri Elektro is not set up.

nothing_to_shed.message: No device could be shed (none is on, or all are already shed).

restore_all.name: Restore all shed devices
restore_all.description: Turn back on every device that Namudri auto-shed (ignores min off time).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional. If omitted, applies to all Namudri instances.

force_shed.name: Force shed next device
force_shed.description: Turn off the next device in priority order right now (ignores the projection; needs load shedding enabled).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional. If omitted, applies to all Namudri instances.

power_sensor_unavailable.title: Power sensor not available
power_sensor_unavailable.description: The power sensor {entity_id} has been unavailable or has not been updating for more than 10 minutes, so no devices are shed. Check the sensor or pick another one in Settings → Devices & services → Namudri Elektro.

agreed_power_not_set.title: Agreed power is not set
agreed_power_not_set.description: Load shedding is on and devices are configured, but the agreed power of {blocks} is 0, so nothing is shed in that block. Set it on the Namudri Elektro device page or turn load shedding off.
